sentences.text: Hello and welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
My name is Emily.
I am happy you are here.
Today, we will talk about Singapore.
Singapore is a small, clean and modern country
in Southeast Asia.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Are you ready?
Let's begin.
Where is Singapore?
Singapore is in Southeast Asia.
It is south of Malaysia and near Indonesia.
It is an island country in the Pacific Ocean.
Singapore is very small, but it is also very important.
What is the capital city of Singapore?
The capital city is Singapore.
Yes, the whole country is one big city.
That's why it is called a city state.
Singapore has skyscrapers, gardens, museums and markets.
It is a mix of old and new.
How many people live in Singapore?
About 6 million people live in Singapore.
People come from many ethnic groups and cultures.
The largest groups are Chinese, Malay, Indian and Eurasian.
It is a multicultural and international place.
What language do people speak in Singapore?
Singapore has four official languages.
English used in schools and work.
Mandarin Chinese, Malay Tamil.
Most people speak English and also speak a second or third language.
Many people use singlish, a mix of English and local expressions.
What is the weather like in Singapore?
Singapore has a tropical climate.
That means it is hot and humid all year.
There is rain almost every week.
There is no winter.
Most days are around 30-degree sessions.
People wear light clothes and stay cool indoors.
What does Singapore look like?
Singapore has tall buildings and monroads,
gardens like gardens by the bay,
beaches and parks, shopping centers,
temples and mosques.
It is very green, very clean and very safe.
What animals live in Singapore?
In nature parks and reserves you can find monkeys,
otters, lizards and snakes,
colorful birds and butterflies.
People love going to the Singapore Zoo and bird paradise.
In the city you may even see wild otters near the river.
What do people eat in Singapore?
Singapore is famous for delicious food.
It is a mix of Chinese, Malay, Indian and Western food.
Popular dishes include chicken rice,
laksa, spicy noodle soup,
satay, grilled meat on sticks,
roti prata, flatbread with curry,
chili crab, crab and spicy tomato sauce.
People eat at hawker centers,
open-air food courts with many stalls.
What do people drink in Singapore?
People drink iced tea and iced coffee.
Fresh juices like sugar cane or watermelon,
soy milk, bandung, a pink drink made from rose syrup
and milk and of course water because it's hot.
What is life like in Singapore?
Life in Singapore is busy, safe and organized.
People go to school, work and enjoy modern life.
Public transport is fast and on time.
People enjoy shopping, eating out,
visiting parks and museums,
watching movies and going to libraries.
Singapore is also great for families and children.
What are some holidays and traditions in Singapore?
Because Singapore is multicultural,
there are many holidays.
Chinese New Year,
with red decorations and lion dances.
Hari-Raya Idol-Fitri,
a Muslim celebration after Ramadan.
Deepa Vali,
the Hindu festival of lights,
Christmas with lights and shopping.
National Day, August 9th,
with parades and fireworks.
People respect all cultures and celebrate together.
Some fun facts about Singapore.
Singapore is one of the cleanest countries in the world.
You can get a fine for littering or chewing gum in public.
The national flower is the Vanda Miss Joaquim Orchid.
Singapore has one of the best airports in the world,
Changi Airport.
The Singapore flag is red and white with a moon and five stars.
Now you know many things about Singapore.
You know where it is, what people speak,
and what the food is like.
You learned about the culture, animals and daily life.
Great job!
I am Emily.
Goodbye.
Or as they say in Malay,
Sala Matingal.
